axioms.source: exclusive epistemic states re the same p
the restriction is on sharing i; sharing i violates it by definition
flat sincere assertion and uncertainty-flagged response are exclusive response modes for the same p
endorsement of a reliance presupposes the reliance is sought
harm from a false impression presupposes the false impression
business reason atom is only meaningful for an operator restriction; pilot simplification — the OpenAI-spec build should generalize this
